Product Owner ruling, agent-mediated on 2026-10-05 (`execution_prompt.md` §5.3) and confirmed by the human Product Owner on 2026-10-05. A recorded "none found" answer replaces any quota. - A roster rule for reduced windows while a pull-forward is mandatory. - A STEP 4 Notes tally line. Premise correction: the escalation's statement that no new feature-shaped idea had surfaced was inaccurate. The pool emptied; it did not fail to fill. Near-term pool for v9.10: - `BLG-FE-193`, seatable once `BLG-BE-135` (v9.9) ships; - `BLG-FEAT-59`, gate cleared 2026-10-05 per `docs/ops/ai_feature_usage_review_2026-09-24.md`.
